## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `list_assets` | `list_assets(chain_id: int, tokens_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Native currency followed by the given ERC-20 descriptors, as asset rows. |
| `get_balances` | `get_balances(chain_id: int, address: tstr, tokens_json: tstr, token_sort: tstr) -> tstr` | One Multicall3 read for native and every given token balance. |
| `build_transfer` | `build_transfer(chain_id: int, request_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Build exactly one unsigned native or ERC-20 call, resolved among native and the request's `tokens`. |
| `resolve_asset` | `resolve_asset(chain_id: int, key: tstr, tokens_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Resolve native or one given token by exact address or unambiguous symbol. |
| `decorate_history` | `decorate_history(history_json: tstr, tokens_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Decorate sender history with `{ "<chainId>": [descriptors] }`, native only for a chain the map omits. |
